required_prerequisites: Strict command-line scoping to single tenant ID (tenant_941)
Removal of --repair-nulls global flag which re-assigns unpartitioned records to communal pool
reasoning_summary: Inspection of scripts/sync_ledger.py reveals that running with --tenant=all and --repair-nulls executes an UPDATE query reassigning NULL tenant records to 'SHARED_COMMUNAL'. This causes cross-tenant data contamination and leaks private customer data, directly violating tenant isolation policy SEC-DATA-09.
recommended_action: Refuse global execution. Run script strictly scoped to the reporting tenant: python scripts/sync_ledger.py --tenant=tenant_941 without repair-nulls.
